augments.name: Heat Sink Plating
augments.desc: Built for solar flares: 50% fewer breaches and a 15% chance to shrug off system damage.

augments.name: Storm Grounding Rods
augments.desc: A 35% chance to shrug off ion damage.

sectors.name: The Furnace
sectors.blurb: A cluster of angry blue stars. Solar flares at almost every beacon, and rich salvage from those who burned.
intro: Three suns overhead. Your crew start handing out extinguishers.
The Furnace. Keep the fire doors handy.

sectors.name: The Shattered Belt
sectors.blurb: What is left of a moon. Rocks everywhere, slow going for the fleet, hard going for you.
intro: Rocks the size of cities tumble past the canopy.
The Shattered Belt. Shields up and stay up.

sectors.name: The Pulsar Field
sectors.blurb: Spinning dead stars sweep the sector with ion waves. Systems flicker on and off all day.
intro: Your lights blink off, then on again, to the beat of a dead star.
The Pulsar Field. Ion-proof everything you can.

events.text: A wrecked freighter is falling slowly into the star. Its hold is intact, for now.

success.text: You pull the cargo out with seconds to spare.

fail.text: You get the cargo, and a scorched hull.

choices.text: Grab what you can from the edge.

events.text: A sunshade station hangs in the glare, its crew offering to refit ships for the flares.

choices.text: Buy the heat sink plating (35 scrap).

effect.text: Your hull gleams like a mirror.
An hour out of the glare does everyone good.

events.text: A pyrate is riding an asteroid like a surfboard, laughing. He waves you over to join.

effect.text: You surf the belt like a pro. The pyrate is so impressed he gives you his stash.

events.text: Deep in the belt, a cracked asteroid shows a core of raw, glowing metal.

fail.text: The core shifts and pins your ship for hours.

events.text: A research lab studies the pulsars. The scientists offer their storm gear in return for a ride.

effect.text: They install grounding rods as a thank you, and one stays on as crew.
Their charts show every safe beacon.

events.text: The pulsar's beat is perfectly regular. Your engineer says you could time a jump between pulses and save fuel.

success.text: Perfect timing. The jump costs nothing.

fail.text: Off by a beat. Everything goes dark for a moment.
